import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge(int to, int c, int f, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int r, c;
        Pair(int r, int c) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int[] X = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] Y = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
    static int[] d, ptr;
    static int s, t, n, tbad;
    static char[][] a, b;
    static int[][][][] dst = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static int[] bad = new int[2]; // [r,c] of 'Z'

    static void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, cap, 0, 0));
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, 0, 0, 0));
        g[v].get(g[v].size()-1).rev = g[u].size()-1;
        g[u].get(g[u].size()-1).rev = g[v].size()-1;
    }

    static boolean buildLevNet() {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                if (d[e.to] == INF && e.c - e.f > 0) {
                    d[e.to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int curFlow) {
        if (v == t) return curFlow;
        while (ptr[v] < g[v].size()) {
            int i = ptr[v];
            Edge e = g[v].get(i);
            int to = e.to;
            int cf = e.c - e.f;
            if (d[to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                int addFlow = dfs(to, Math.min(curFlow, cf));
                if (addFlow > 0) {
                    e.f += addFlow;
                    g[to].get(e.rev).f -= addFlow;
                    return addFlow;
                }
            }
            ptr[v]++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinica() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevNet()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int add;
            while ((add = dfs(s, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += add;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean check(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n && a[r][c] != 'Y' && a[r][c] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs(int xs, int ys) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dst[xs][ys][i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        dst[xs][ys][xs][ys] = 0;
        Queue<Pair> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        queue.add(new Pair(xs, ys));
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = queue.poll();
            // skip if distance from (xs,ys) equals distance from bad, unless (xs,ys) is the bad itself
            if (dst[xs][ys][v.r][v.c] == dst[bad[0]][bad[1]][v.r][v.c] && (bad[0] != xs || bad[1] != ys)) continue;
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nr = v.r + X[dir];
                int nc = v.c + Y[dir];
                if (check(nr, nc) && dst[xs][ys][nr][nc] == INF &&
                    dst[xs][ys][v.r][v.c] + 1 <= dst[bad[0]][bad[1]][nr][nc]) {
                    dst[xs][ys][nr][nc] = dst[xs][ys][v.r][v.c] + 1;
                    queue.add(new Pair(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scan.nextInt();
        tbad = scan.nextInt();
        a = new char[n][n];
        b = new char[n][n];

        int px = -1, py = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scan.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scan.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        bad[0] = px;
        bad[1] = py;

        // allocate graph after knowing n
        int V = 2 * n * n + 2;
        g = new ArrayList[V];
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[V];
        ptr = new int[V];
        s = 0;
        t = 2 * n * n + 1;

        bfs(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dst[px][py][i][j] = Math.min(dst[px][py][i][j], tbad);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (check(i, j)) bfs(i, j);
            }
        }

        // build flow network
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0') addEdge(s, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                if (b[i][j] != '0') addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, t, b[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!check(i, j)) continue;
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                        if (!check(i1, j1)) continue;
                        if (dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinica());
    }
}
